law_record.title: Stopping, standing or parking in alley (1)(a)
law_record.text: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction, a person shall not: Stop, stand or park a vehicle within an alley in a business district except for the expeditious loading or unloading of goods.

activation_conditions: the alley is in a business district
the subject stops, stands or parks in it for something other than expeditious loading or unloading of goods
exceptions: expeditious loading or unloading of goods
unless a local ordinance provides otherwise
residue: 'business district' is a legal region class — a reading assumption
the loading purpose is evidenced only by goods and doors observed
this line is in the corpus because the narrower municipal text that superseded it is unresolvable
